ValidationRule.description: Requires a churn explanation at the moment an account is created as, or changed to, Former. Accounts that were already Former without an explanation stay editable so roll-ups, integrations and reps are not blocked (narrowed Sep 2026).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Former"), ISBLANK(( Churn_Explanation__c )), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Status__c)), NOT($Permission.Bypass_At_Risk_Validation) )
